$comment: Single source of truth for the binary frame format. Run `npm run gen:protocol` after editing.

streamHeader.name: first
streamHeader.$comment: Position of this frame's first record in its stream: how many the page recorded before it. A resend after a reconnect repeats positions, so the server takes each record once

streams.name: overhead
streams.$comment: Agent self-time measured with performance.now() (Date.now() fallback) per tick window

streams.name: lag
streams.$comment: How late the agent's 1 Hz timer fired. A cheap event-loop blockage probe that works on every engine

streams.name: longtask
streams.$comment: PerformanceObserver longtask entries; t is the task's startTime

streams.name: frame
streams.$comment: requestAnimationFrame timestamps, recorded only during a capture

streams.name: input
streams.$comment: keydown, and how long until the next animation frame started (-1 if no frame was seen)

fields.name: delayMs
fields.$comment: key event to handler, ms; -1 when the engine stamped no usable time

streams.name: resource
streams.$comment: Resource Timing entries; t is startTime. name indexes the agent's string table (65535 = table full), kind indexes resourceKinds. ttfbMs is -1 when the engine hides it

streams.name: video
streams.$comment: Per <video> element, sampled at 1 Hz: cumulative decoded and dropped frame counts and currentTime

streams.name: heap
streams.$comment: performance.memory at 1 Hz, in bytes. Chrome quantizes these unless precise memory info is enabled

streams.name: link
streams.$comment: At the 1 Hz tick: bytes queued on the agent's and the inspector's sockets, the inspector's main-thread time in its last second, its governor level, and the JS heap limit (0 when unknown). Sent on the agent's socket so a stuck inspector socket is still visible

streams.name: dom
streams.$comment: Element count, every 5 s, from a live getElementsByTagName('*') collection

streams.name: keytarget
streams.$comment: The focused element when a key was pressed; t matches the input record's t. target indexes the string table (65535 = none or table full)

fields.name: landing
fields.$comment: where focus came to rest after the key, read at its frame; indexes the string table

fields.name: moved
fields.$comment: 1 when focus left the element the key was pressed on, 0 when it stayed, 255 unknown

streams.name: keyphase
streams.$comment: One sampled key press broken into phases, in ms; t matches the input record's t, -1 when a phase couldn't be measured. inputDelay: event.timeStamp to the agent's capture listener. handlers: to the window bubble listener (or the next task if propagation stopped). waitFrame: to the first animation-frame callback. raf: to the agent's last callback, so the app's rAF work. style and layout: forcing a computed style read, then offsetHeight. paint: from there to the next task, so paint, compositing update and commit
